goal: Extract logout lifecycle and logout-specific state from CasConfiguration to reduce the number of unrelated public methods and simplify internal initialization.

ops.details: Create CasLogoutConfiguration in the same package. Move logoutHandler, postLogoutUrlParameter, initializeLogoutHandler, and their accessors into the extracted class. Retain CasConfiguration methods with their existing signatures as delegating adapters. Preserve the existing default initialization with DefaultLogoutHandler and the init behavior of findLogoutHandler.

Add a CasLogoutConfiguration instance to CasConfiguration, delegate logout initialization and accessors to it, and update internalInit and toString to obtain logout values through the extracted component. Preserve the existing public API and output values.
